title: Santé Raises $15M Series A To Redefine Liquor Stores
body_markdown:
We raised $15M to set the standard in wine & spirits retail.


‍


We 5x’d in 2025, and we’ve 5x’d again this year with three months ahead to continue growing.


‍


At Santé, we’re pioneering applied AI for liquor stores:


‍


- Increasing eComm sales by 65%+ with custom websites
- Cutting $25k in payroll with agents that execute inventory receiving and ordering
- Saving thousands ($$) on pricing mistakes hidden in a sea of SKUs


‍


Having the best product in market has allowed us to cut sales cycles by 48%, going from 35 days to 18 days per deal.


‍


These entrepreneurs are so eager to thrive with Santé, they’ll complete an entire migration in 2 days.


‍


With this capital, we’re building a winning team with the fire to do whatever it takes to redefine an entire industry.


‍


Special thanks to Fintop for leading the round and to our other top investors who doubled down: Bonfire Ventures, Veridical Ventures, Operator Collective and TipTop VC.


‍
